surfaces.says: Claude Code reads CLAUDE.md at the repository root as project instructions, and one sub-agent definition per Markdown file under .claude/agents/ -- YAML front-matter carrying name and description, the body as the agent's instructions. Taken from the product's documentation; a claim until a run of the product is observed reading what was served. It reads project settings at .claude/settings.json, whose PreToolUse hooks receive the tool event as JSON on stdin (tool_input.file_path, and content / new_string / edits[].new_string) and refuse the tool call when the command exits 2, its stderr shown to the model. Hook payload keys and the exit-2 refusal are measured on a prior hand-built system on this machine (pre_write_context, post_write_block, pre_exec_block proven by receipt); served by THIS kit, not yet observed. Scoped law: it also reads a CLAUDE.md in a subdirectory when it works on files there (nested memory, loaded on demand) -- taken from the product's memory documentation; UNVERIFIED on this machine until a session is observed citing a served scoped file. Skills: one directory per skill under .claude/skills/ holding SKILL.md (front matter `name`, `description`, optional `allowed-tools`) and its supporting files -- taken from the product's skills documentation (fetched 2026-10-16); a claim until a run is observed loading a served skill. MCP: project servers in .mcp.json (`mcpServers`; stdio `command`/`args`/`env`, http `type`/`url`/`headers`; `${VAR}` expanded in command, args, env, url and headers), approved by `enabledMcpjsonServers` in .claude/settings.json (ignored until the workspace is trusted), tools named `mcp__<server>__<tool>` in `permissions.allow`/`deny` -- taken from the product's MCP and settings documentation (fetched 2026-10-16); a claim until a run is observed. An untrusted server's undeclared tools are ASKED about, not denied: deny outranks allow, so this product cannot deny all but a list -- the strongest it can say is said. Pre-exec and pre-spawn: PreToolUse hooks matching `Bash` (tool_input.command) and `Agent|Task` (tool_input.prompt, tool_input.subagent_type) run `guard` and `spawn` -- taken from the product's hooks documentation; a claim until a receipt shows them fired. Session lifecycle: SessionStart (matcher startup|resume|clear|compact; plain stdout, or hookSpecificOutput.additionalContext with hookEventName SessionStart, is added to the model's context; exit 2 blocks nothing), Stop (no matcher; exit 2 refuses the stop and its stderr becomes the model's reason to continue; stop_hook_active is true while a stop hook keeps the turn going, and the product ends the turn after 8 consecutive refusals) and SubagentStop (agent_id, agent_type, agent_transcript_path, last_assistant_message; no model and no token field) -- taken from the product's hooks documentation (fetched 2026-10-16); a claim until a receipt shows them fired. The sub-agent transcript's shape is MEASURED on this machine (Claude Code 2.1.301, 2026-10-16, five sub-agent transcripts): lines of type `assistant` carry the top-level `requestedModel`, `message.model`, `message.id` and `message.usage` (input_tokens, output_tokens, cache_read_input_tokens, cache_creation_input_tokens), and one turn is written as several lines sharing a message.id whose usage can differ, the last holding the turn's final count -- so the ledger keeps the last line per id. The stop gate is served only where the host takes a continuity capsule.

limits.says: The Agent Skills specification recommends a SKILL.md body under 5000 tokens; Claude Code truncates a skill listing's description at 1536 characters -- from the products' documentation

memory.says: Claude Code's auto memory lives at ~/.claude/projects/<project>/memory/ (MEMORY.md index, first 200 lines or 25 KB loaded every session), <project> derived from the git repository path -- from the product's memory documentation (fetched 2026-10-16); the slug form (every character outside A-Z, a-z, 0-9 becomes '-') is MEASURED on this machine against a session's own memory directory.
